summary: Aerolink previously advertised $5 in one-time testing credits for eligible new accounts after verification and abuse checks, valid for 30 days, with no recurring free plan. On 2026-10-24 the pricing and registration pages no longer mention the testing credit (it was shown on 2026-10-23), and no end notice was found. Confirm the credit in your dashboard before relying on it.
claim_steps: Generate an API key from the dashboard and point your client at the Aerolink base URL.
Check your account dashboard for the $5 testing credit before relying on it: the pricing page no longer advertised it on 2026-10-24 and no end notice was found. When shown, it is valid for 30 days.
